description: This bar chart illustrates the average performance of various language models on November 2024 AMC 10/12 tests. The horizontal axis displays the model names—Llama-3.3 70B Instruct, Claude 3 Sonnet, Qwen 2.5 14b-Instruct, GPT 4o, GPT 4o-mini, Qwen 2.5 72b-Instruct, Gemini 1.5, Gemini Pro 1.5, and Phi-4—listed alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Average score (temperature = 0.5),” is a linear scale ranging from 60 to 92, with tick marks at intervals of 10, representing the average score.  For each model, two bars are presented side-by-side: one light blue representing the “Small model” and one dark blue representing the “Large model.” Each bar has an error bar extending above and below it, indicated by a black line.  The “Small model” bar for Llama-3.3 70B Instruct reaches approximately 66.4, while the corresponding “Large model” reaches 74.8. The “Small model” bar for Phi-4 reaches approximately 91.8 and the corresponding “Large model” bar reaches approximately 89.8. The bars are sorted alphabetically by model name, and all bars and error bars are displayed in black.
